Understanding the integration scheme and correctly averaging the energy differences for free energy estimation is research‑grade; translating it into correct code demands genuine understanding of statistical physics.

Overall, moderate orchestration with one heavy computational block.

The pipeline involves simulation for six cluster sizes and outputting values, which is moderate in complexity but not a multi-stage orchestration.
